correctness.rationale: Verified head-to-toe. Kasteleyn symbol P(z,w)=|1+az|^2+|1+aw|^2>0 on torus (min 0.5 at a=1/2) certifies smooth phase at B=0; Kenyon Fourier formulas p1=U+aC, pa=aC+a^2U give exact gap p1-pa=(1-a^2)U with U=E[1/P]>0; Jensen U>=1/E[P]=1/2.5 yields analytic gap>=0.30 with no numerics needed. Independently re-ran compute_gap.py: U~0.5081, p1~0.4405, pa~0.0595, gap~0.381, identities E[P/P]=1 and 2p1+2pa=1 hold, grid-independent 400^2 vs 1600^2. Facet slope-constancy (Ronkin linear on bounded amoeba components) and Chhita-Johansson gas-region K^{-1} convergence to the periodic smooth kernel (Theorem 2.6, exponential error) are correctly cited as lemmas, not re-proved; DRAFT honestly separates proved vs cited vs computed. Two-parity sequences in nF plus triangle inequality max(|p1-q0|,|pa-q0|)>=(p1-pa)/2>=0.15 rigorously refutes both the C/n bound and convergence itself for any slope-only q0.

The gap identity and Jensen bound are elementary but unstated as a rate refutation; the O(1) two-parity witness with sup-error >=0.15 is new. Adversarial checks for synonyms, dual/matrix encodings, broader theorems, tables, and corollary-repackaging all negative. Timestamp alone was not used; substantive comparison was.

The object (2-periodic (1,a) Aztec, a=1/2 as representative with general formula for all 0<a<1), invariant (exact analytic gap >=0.30), and question (finite-size Kasteleyn local-limit rate) were motivated before computation; the value is not known or mechanically implied and future researchers need the precise corrected formulation.
